selection: Lowest source panel hash per stratum across existing 40 F4 source queries; no target outcome selection. Two cyclic target seeds. Positive source energy and source-negative energy select disjoint-document sequences within each query.
intervention: Subtract signed aggregate source-local projection or predicted transport at natural amplitude. Wrong-query also norm matched. All compared against same source intervention.
budget: Eight source queries, two target seeds, up to four sequences, two ranks, four controls: at most 640 forwards, local GPU, no training or new download.
